purpose: Determine whether a limited set of persistent team-at-venue home-field deviations can safely survive additional shrinkage beyond the validated 2.082 league baseline, without granting blanket authority to the 32 raw H2 team/venue estimates.

sourceAuthority.primary: Billy Walters with Armen Keteyian, Gambler, Chapters 21-22
sourceAuthority.rule: Home advantage can differ by city/team and over time, but a current production deviation must be earned empirically rather than inferred from reputation or imported from a market price.
sourceAuthority.interpretation: H3V treats the H2 team+stadium coefficient as a team-at-venue signal, not as a pure stadium causal effect. Altitude, weather, travel, rest, surface and crowd narratives do not receive separate production credit here.

internalRollingCalibration.nextSeasonBaselineRule: Use the H2 global baseline plus a recency-weighted average of up to the three most recent fitted season home deviations; for early folds with fewer than three seasons, use every available fitted season with weights 1..N oldest-to-newest.

survivalCoefficient.formula: k = clip(sum(d_i * r_i) / sum(d_i^2), 0, 1), where d_i is the prior-fit team-at-venue deviation and r_i is the next-season domestic residual versus league-only HFA after validation-only team-strength nuisance fitting.
survivalCoefficient.rule: Estimate one universal persistence/shrinkage coefficient across all internal rolling-fold domestic games. Do not hand-pick a venue-specific weight.

venueQualification.rule: A venue qualifies only from evidence available before the untouched 2025 confirmation. Qualification uses the 2021-2024 fit and 2022-2024 rolling out-of-sample evidence; 2025 may confirm or reject the selective layer as a whole but may not add a venue to the qualified set.
venueQualification.productionProjectionIfConfirmed: 2026 HFA = 2.082 league baseline + k * final H2 teamVenueDeviationPoints for a prequalified unchanged team-at-venue pair; all other ordinary domestic venues remain at the league baseline.

activeWeekShadow.rule: Recompute every active-week shadow fair from H3 preservedNonLocationExactFairHome plus the selective H3V location term. Preserve personnel overlays, QB/game-factor adjustments and carried ratings exactly.

doubleCountGuards.altitude: Do not identify an H3V venue adjustment as a separate altitude factor; any future altitude S-factor requires explicit reconciliation before production.
doubleCountGuards.travelTimezone: Travel and time-zone effects remain future S-factor inputs and may not be added inside H3V.
doubleCountGuards.weather: Weather remains a future W-factor input and may not be added inside H3V.
doubleCountGuards.surface: Surface remains separate unless a later governed study explicitly decomposes it.
doubleCountGuards.teamStrength: Never move carried team currentRating from H3V.
doubleCountGuards.personnel: Never alter or reapply personnelOverlayPointsToHomeSpread from H3V.

h4Rule: H4 may activate selective venue adjustments only if H3V reaches PASS_SELECTIVE_VENUE_H4_CANDIDATE. If H3V fails or qualifies no venues, H4 remains the already accepted league-baseline plus neutral-zero scope.
